jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

**Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.**

In the age of AI, Microsoft Security empowers defenders with unified Microsoft Security products and platforms and new AI-driven solutions to help customers protect their organizations at machine speed. Microsoft Defender Experts (DEX) is Microsoft's premier Managed Detection & Response (MDR) service, providing 24/7 protection for customers.

 **Responsibilities**

Customer Focus & Problem Solving: Engage deeply with internal and external customers to understand security operations tools and processes, identify unmet needs, and drive innovative integrations that deliver measurable customer value. ·

Product Strategy, Definition & Roadmap: Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for MDR capabilities; identify gaps and opportunities; define and prioritize requirements as clear customer scenarios, backlog items, and success metrics (OKRs). ·

Technical & Security Excellence: Ground solutions in strong technical and security fundamentals by partnering with engineering to drive automation and advanced AI. Apply deep SOC operations expertise and threat-landscape awareness to deliver effective detection, response, and resilience.

Data-Driven Decision Making: Define, instrument, and track KPIs across the DEX service.

Leverage analytics and telemetry to generate insights, guide prioritization, and drive continuous improvements.

·Cross-Team Collaboration: Identify broad security challenges and lead cross-team solutions with partner teams across Microsoft Security. Build inclusive, high-trust partnerships. ·

Operational Excellence & Execution: Partner with engineering to establish disciplined execution rhythms, accurate planning, and scalable operational processes. ·

Evangelization and amplification: Represent the product and service in executive reviews, customer briefings, and internal and external forums.

 **Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development OR equivalent experience.
* 4+ years experience improving product metrics for a product, feature, or experience in a market (e.g., growing customer base, expanding customer usage, avoiding customer churn). ·
* Hands-on experience in building security products and security domain knowledge ; operating at scale in global, high-availability services; data analytics and metrics skills; strong leadership and communication in ambiguous situations.
* Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements, including a Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager – Visibility, Shipment Technologies
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon’s Shipment Technologies (STS) team is responsible for key technology that enables planning, orchestration, and execution of transportation service to deliver billions of packages to Amazon.com customer globally. Our goal is to ensure the best delivery experience for customers across all geographies through a highly scalable, adaptive, and autonomous transportation network.  
  
We are looking for a product leader to own our global transportation visibility and intelligence products. They will own critical Amazon services that aggregate real-time data from our transportation network combined with predictive supply chain data to drive automation, efficiency, and visibility. These services allow us to identify problems that could impact on-time delivery, take proactive actions to mitigate network and package level problems, and keep customers informed on what is happening.  
  
The ideal candidate is capable of breaking down and solving complex problems, and has a strong will to get things done! You will work on real world problems on a global scale. You own your products end-to-end and influence the direction of our product and technology which impacts hundreds-of-millions of customers around the world. You are a hands-on, pragmatic problem solver that easily balances trade-offs between competing interests. You thrive in a fast-moving team environment where you are able to juggle complex dependencies and requirements while producing optimal solutions.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Serve as the subject matter expert in transportation visibility and intelligence, leveraging your deep domain knowledge to identify market trends, customer pain points, and opportunities for product enhancement  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and customer success, to translate business requirements into technical specifications and drive the successful implementation of new product features and enhancements  
Develop a comprehensive product roadmap that aligns with the company's overall strategic objectives and effectively communicates it to stakeholders  
Continuously gather and analyze customer feedback, market intelligence, and industry insights to inform product decisions and ensure the delivery of high-value solutions  
Champion a customer-centric design approach, working closely with Operational, Business, and UX team to optimize the user experience and drive product adoption  
Manage the product lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring that milestones are met, risks are mitigated, and the product is delivered on time and within budget

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**The Team**

Partner Relationship Management (PRM) is one of the newest products inside ServiceNow’s Sales CRM organization, built to help companies run their entire partner ecosystem, from deal registration through MDF to partner facing commerce, natively on the Now Platform. The product is just over a year old. This is a genuine zero to one opportunity: the foundational architecture exists, the first design partners are live, and the roadmap for the next phase is still being written by the people building it today.

**What You Get to Do in This Role**

* Own product strategy and roadmap for a defined slice of PRM, from discovery through launch and adoption
* Work directly with design partner customers to validate problems before committing engineering investment, and translate their feedback into clear, buildable requirements
* Partner with engineering scrum teams in India day to day to break down epics, sequence releases, and make tradeoffs under real delivery constraints
* Define and document detailed specs, acceptance criteria, and data models for complex partner ecosystem workflows (partner hierarchies, deal registration, approvals, MDF, catalog driven quoting)
* Collaborate with design and research to shape partner facing and internal facing experiences, from early concepts through usability validation
* Represent PRM in cross functional forums across GTM, design, research, and other stakeholder groups, and build consensus on shared priorities
* Contribute to competitive positioning and help the team understand how PRM should be differentiated against established players in the partner management space
* Mentor and influence product thinking across the broader team, given the staff level scope of this role

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 12+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product area end to end in a B2B SaaS environment
* Experience building or scaling products in the partner ecosystem, channel, or partner relationship management space
* Strong technical fluency, comfortable going deep with engineering on data models, workflow logic, and system architecture
* Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity and build structure where none exists, this is a zero to one environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing stakeholders across geographies and time zones
* Comfortable working with distributed, India based engineering and global product peers across North America

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience with partner relationship management, channel management, or partner ecosystem platforms such as Impartner, PartnerStack, ZINFI, Salesforce Partner Cloud/Community Cloud, SAP, Oracle, or Conga/Apttus
* Experience with CRM, CPQ, quote to cash, or order management systems

jobs.title: Manager – Business Development & Sales Pharmaceutical Consultancy Services
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:** The Manager Business Development & Sales will be responsible for driving new business, account growth and revenue for Neovation consultancy services across Medical Affairs, Commercial and Market Access functions within pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies.

Based in Hyderabad, this is a target-driven, highly client-facing individual contributor role for an experienced pharmaceutical sales professional who is ready to move beyond traditional product selling into a more consultative, solution led business development role.

The individual will spend a significant part of their time meeting customers, developing accounts and identifying business opportunities. Success in this role will come from understanding a client’s business and scientific needs, asking the right questions, identifying where Neovation can add value, and working with internal subject matter experts to develop relevant solutions.

The role owns the complete business development cycle from opening doors and developing relationships to shaping solutions, negotiating commercials, closing projects, ensuring effective handover and supporting timely revenue realization.

**Responsibilities**

* **Revenue and Sales Target Ownership:**
* Own and achieve assigned sales, revenue and new business targets for Neovation
* Build and maintain a healthy opportunity pipeline through prospecting, referrals, networking, existing relationships and systematic account development
* Identify opportunities across Medical Affairs, Commercial, Market Access and other relevant functions within pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies
* Manage opportunities through the complete business development cycle from initial conversation and needs discovery to solution development, proposal, pricing, negotiation and closure
* Maintain clear visibility of the pipeline, forecasts, account plans and progress against agreed targets
* Continuously identify opportunities to expand existing accounts through new stakeholders, functions and service area
* **Consultative Client Engagement & Account Development:**
* Spend approximately 80% of working time on external, client facing business development activities, with regular in-person customer meetings being a core expectation of the role.
* Develop strong relationships with decision makers and influencers across Medical Affairs, Commercial, Market Access and other relevant functions.
* Engage with customers to understand their business priorities, scientific requirements, challenges and operational needs, rather than approaching conversations with a predefined service or product.
* Translate these requirements into relevant opportunities where Neovation’s capabilities can provide value.
* Develop a strong understanding of key accounts, including their organisational structure, therapy areas, portfolios, stakeholders, current priorities and potential areas of engagement.
* Build relationships beyond individual contacts to create broader and more sustainable account partnerships.
* Engage procurement, vendor management and finance stakeholders early enough to understand and navigate vendor onboarding, contracting, purchase orders, compliance requirements and payment processes.
* Grow existing accounts through regular engagement, relationship development, service reviews, cross-selling and identification of new project opportunities.
* **Solution Development & Opportunity Conversion:**
* Work closely with Neovation’s scientific, medical, strategy and delivery teams to develop solutions that address identified customer requirements.
* Translate customer discussions into clear internal briefs so that proposals accurately reflect the client’s objectives, expectations and scope.
* Coordinate development of project scope, estimates, timelines and commercials with relevant internal stakeholders.
* Present and discuss proposed solutions with customers, incorporating feedback and refining the approach where required.
* Lead commercial discussions, pricing negotiations and follow-ups to progress opportunities towards closure.
* Take ownership of opportunities until the project is commercially confirmed and the necessary documentation is in place.
* **Commercial Governance and Receivables:**
* Ensure commercial terms and payment expectations are clearly agreed with customers before project initiation.
* Coordinate with procurement and other customer stakeholders to ensure timely receipt of purchase orders, contracts and required documentation.
* Maintain visibility of invoicing and outstanding receivables across assigned accounts
* Work closely with internal finance teams and relevant customer stakeholders to ensure payments are received within agreed timelines.
* Proactively identify and escalate payment risks, scope changes or commercial issues that may impact project profitability or revenue realization.

**Qualification and Skillsets:**

* Preferably 5 to 8 years of successful, target driven sales/business development experience within the pharmaceutical/biotechnology/healthcare service industry.
* Candidates currently or previously working as an Area Sales Manager, Regional Sales Manager, Zonal Sales Manager/Business development manager or equivalent may be well suited, particularly those looking to transition into a broader B2B and consultative business development role.
* Proven track record of achieving monthly, quarterly and annual sales or revenue targets
* Strong ability to develop business through relationship building, networking, account development and disciplined follow up.
* Ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders within pharmaceutical organisations.
* Existing industry relationships and networks would be an advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to understand customer needs, identify opportunities, present solutions, negotiate commercials and close business.
* Experience working with procurement, finance and vendor management teams, including purchase orders, contracting…

jobs.description:
**Join the Team Modernizing Medicine**

At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

**A Culture of Excellence**

When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

* **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work**
* **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked #1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture-Backed Company of the Year

We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**

**Job Description Summary:**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on, data-fluent **Technical Product Owner – Product Analytics & Telemetry** to serve as the single source of truth for our product performance, user adoption, and platform utilization.

In this role, you won't just manage a backlog, you will dig directly into complex datasets across Databricks, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, WalkMe, and Datadog to quantify the real-world impact of our Jira initiatives. You will bridge the gap between engineering telemetry, product instrumentation, and business strategy, building the dashboards and executive narratives that dictate our roadmap investments.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Multi-Source Telemetry Extraction:** Query, blend, and analyze data across diverse infrastructure layers—including Databricks Delta Lake, Snowflake, relational databases (PostgreSQL), in-app workflow telemetry (WalkMe), and operational logs (Datadog).
* **Lakehouse Dashboards & Visualization:** Architect and maintain high-performance Databricks SQL dashboards and visualizations to track cohort adoption, funnel drop-offs, feature utilization, and user retention.
* **Initiative Quantification & ROI:** Map downstream user telemetry directly back to Jira initiatives and epics. Measure feature rollout velocity against actual adoption metrics to validate product bets.
* **Executive Storytelling & Roadmapping:** Synthesize raw analytical outputs into structured, executive-level presentations that highlight adoption bottlenecks, quantify platform usage, and drive prioritization.
* **Telemetry Governance & Instrumentation:** Partner with core engineering and data platform teams to define event taxonomies, tracking specifications, and governance standards, ensuring features launch with production-ready telemetry.
* **Exploratory Data Discovery:** Conduct proactive cohort and behavioral analyses to discover untapped user behavior, navigation friction, and platform optimization opportunities.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* **3–6+ years** of hands-on experience in Senior Product Analyst, Product Analytics, or Analytics Engineering within a modern SaaS/cloud environment.
* **Advanced SQL:** Proven mastery of complex SQL (window functions, recursive CTEs, query optimization, handling semi-structured JSON payloads) across relational (PostgreSQL) and distributed data lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake).
* **Cross-System Data Fluency:** Practical experience pulling or stitching disparate product data from application logs, clickstream tools, guidance software (WalkMe), and cloud storage (e.g., Azure Blob, S3).
* **Databricks Expertise:** Strong familiarity working natively within the Databricks ecosystem (Databricks SQL, Lakeview dashboards, Delta tables).
* **Product Acumen & Agile Delivery:** Solid understanding of modern product management frameworks, Jira project/initiative hierarchies, and KPI definitions (DAU/MAU, activation rates, cohort retention).
* **Executive Communication:** Exceptional ability to build clean, persuasive decks and clearly present technical findings to non-technical leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Educational or applied background in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or Analytics Engineering.
* Working knowledge of PySpark, Python for data manipulation, or dbt.
* Experience operating within cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and understanding Delta Lake architecture.
* Experience defining user event tracking frameworks from scratch (e.g., event naming conventions, schema contracts).

* Meals & Snacks: Enjoy complimentary office lunches & dinners on select days and healthy snacks delivered to your desk,
* Insurance Coverage: Comprehensive health, accidental, and life insurance plans, including coverage for family members, all at no cost to employees,
* Allowances: Annual wellness allowance to support your well-being and productivity,
* Earned, casual, and sick leaves to maintain a healthy work-life balance,

jobs.description:
**About the job**

**Job Title: Business Analyst, CPQ**

**Experience: 7 –9 Years**

**Employment Type:**
Permanent | Full-Time

**Shift & Hours:**
Regular Shift

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Role Overview:**

* We run the Configure-Price-Quote (CPQ) platform for a global enterprise client on Salesforce Sales Cloud and Conga CPQ, with Conga Revenue Lifecycle Management (RLM) being adopted alongside it. The platform lives in a large, shared, multi-domain Salesforce org that serves many business units with a high-volume product catalog. Our mandate is to onboard a long pipeline of commercial offerings, each with its own catalog, pricing, rules, approvals and document templates. The application is documented in a structured knowledge base, so new team members learn from feature pages and process journeys rather than from tribal memory.

**The role**

* You own the functional definition of every offering we onboard. You take a product or pricing owner's description of how they sell, translate it into CPQ constructs, write stories a developer or configurator can execute without coming back to you, and prove the result works with the business in UAT. Conga experience is not required to start. Prior delivery on a CPQ platform is, together with the ability to learn a new one quickly from documentation and configuration data.

**What you will do**

* Run offering intake workshops with commercial, pricing, legal and finance owners and capture the as-is selling process, pricing model and approval paths.
* Model each offering into CPQ terms: product hierarchy, bundles and options, attributes, price lists and price list items, pricing and constraint rules, approval rules, quote and agreement templates.
* Write user stories with testable acceptance criteria, including data readiness, migration and rollback notes.
* Analyze existing configuration and data (price lists, rules, templates, field usage) to find reuse before anything new is created.
* Prepare UAT scenarios and test data, run UAT sessions, triage defects and separate configuration gaps from real bugs.
* Keep the feature documentation of every touched area current as part of each story's definition of done.
* Work daily with the technical lead, CPQ configurators, data engineer and QA, and represent the business view in design reviews.

**Must have:**

* 7+ years as a business analyst or functional consultant on enterprise applications, 3+ of them on any CPQ platform: Salesforce CPQ, Salesforce Industries (Vlocity) CPQ, Oracle CPQ, SAP CPQ, PROS, Zilliant, DealHub, Zuora or Apttus/Conga.
* Working knowledge of quote-to-cash: catalog structure, bundles, attribute-based configuration, list and tiered pricing, discounting, approval matrices, contract generation.
* Proven ability to read configuration data and write precise, unambiguous requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Comfortable with data: advanced Excel, and SOQL or SQL for your own analysis.
* Agile delivery tooling (Jira, Azure DevOps or similar) and documentation tooling (Confluence or similar); strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder management in English.
* Salesforce platform literacy at Administrator level: objects, fields, record types, flows, permission sets.

**Good to have:**

* Conga CPQ or Conga RLM exposure.
* Document generation tools in the Salesforce ecosystem (Conga Composer, DocuSign Gen, Nintex or similar).
* Configuration data migration between orgs (Prodly, Data Loader, scripted loads or similar).
* Salesforce Administrator or Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification.
* Pricing experience in services, subscription or project-based businesses.
* If your CPQ experience is on another platform.

* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

jobs.description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco Cloud Control is Cisco's AI-native platform and the front door to all of Cisco. It is the unified operations platform for agentic IT, and it is designed to be the platform of record for cross-domain operations: one login, one experience across networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. This Platform is a substrate that AI Canvas, the AI Assistant, and Cloud Control Studio are built on, and it's the governed harness that lets operators and AI agents act on real infrastructure safely.
  
A platform of record is only as good as the products standing on it. Convergence comes through reusable platform services: identity, tenancy, authorization, assets, topology, telemetry, search, navigation, audit, and agent actions. Every Cisco product has to come onto those services without losing the depth its customers depend on. That is the work this role owns.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
You be responsible for the end-to-end relationship with the portfolio of products integrating into Cisco Cloud Control. This role is prioritized to integration. We do not own the domain products themselves or the platform services they consume. We own how the two meet: the strategy, the contracts, the sequencing, and the experience a product team has when it comes onto the platform.
  
  

* Lead the integrating product portfolio. Be the single point of contact and the accountable product owner for every product already coming onto Cisco Cloud Control. Hold the plan, the sequencing, the dependencies, and the dates. Escalate early, and bring a decision rather than a status.
* Be responsible for the integration strategy. Define what it means to be on the platform: the tiers of integration, what a product gets at each tier, what it owes in return, and the order in which the portfolio moves through them. Make the calls on identity, entitlement, navigation, telemetry, agent-ready context, and user experience consistency, and hold the line when a single product wants an exception that would fragment the platform.
* Build for self-service. Turn every capability the platform offers into something a product team can embrace on its own: documented contracts, reference implementations, sandboxes, validation tooling, and a platform engagement checklist that gets a team from first contact to production without a meeting series. Treat every support request as a defect in the self-service path.
* Drive the roadmap with engineering. Write the requirements, define the acceptance criteria, and prioritize the platform backlog against what the integrating portfolio actually needs. Partner with platform engineering, design, and the Cisco Unified Identity team on sequencing and trade-offs.
* Align stakeholders at Cisco scale. Work across product management, engineering, design, security, legal, privacy, support, and go-to-market in multiple business units and time zones. Get senior leaders to a shared decision, write it down, and keep it decided.
* Represent the integrating product teams. You are their advocate inside the platform and the platform's advocate inside their planning. Bring their friction back as roadmap, not as anecdote.
* Make it measurable. Define and report the metrics that say whether the platform is scaling: time to integrate, share of products self-serving, integration defects, and the adoption those integrations produce downstream.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 8 or more years in product management, including 4 or more years owning a platform, developer platform, or internal service that other product teams build on.
* Demonstrated ownership of large scale, multi-team programs from strategy through delivery, at the scale of an enterprise portfolio rather than a single product.
* Experience defining and shipping platform capabilities as self-service: documented contracts or application programming interfaces, onboarding guides, and tooling that reduce the need for hands-on support.
* Proven ability to align multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities and drive them to a durable decision.
* Experience with software as a service products, including multi-tenancy, identity and access management, entitlement, and cloud operations.
* Excellent written communication. You can write a one-page decision document that a vice president and a staff engineer both act on.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in a shipping product, and a working grasp of what agentic AI requires from an underlying platform.
* Experience with an enterprise platform consolidation or migration: bringing independent products onto shared identity, navigation, and data foundations.
* Background in networking, security, or observability products.
* Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, application programming interface gateways, and shared user experience component systems.
* Experience building a partner or developer program, including certification, tiering, and self-service onboarding.
* Track record operating across geographic regions and data residency requirements.
* Technical depth sufficient to earn the trust of principal engineers, whether from an engineering background or from years spent close to one.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year
  
  

* Every product in the current integrating portfolio has a named owner, a dated plan, and a published integration tier.
* The platform engagement checklist is live, and new products start on it by default.
* A majority of new integrations reach production without hands-on platform support.
* Time to integrate is measured, published, and trending down.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Delhivery moves millions of shipments a day across one of the most complex physical networks: pickups, line-haul, sorting, last-mile, returns, and cross-border. Every one of those steps generates data, decisions, and money on the table. We believe the next decade of logistics will be won by whoever applies AI most intelligently to the physical world.

We are building a team of Product Managers who will reimagine logistics with an Agentic first approach. You won't be bolting a chatbot on a dashboard. You will own problems where a better model or a smarter agent changes unit economics, customer experience, or network reliability at national scale.

.
**What You’ll Do**

* **Find the right problems.**
  Spend time in hubs, with riders, ops leaders, and merchants. Translate messy operational pain into opportunities for creating a seamless flow that scales.
* **Own outcomes, not outputs.**
  Define success metrics tied to cost per shipment, delivery success, NPS, or revenue, and be accountable for moving them.
* **Ship AI products that real operators use.**
  Design human-in-the-loop workflows, fallbacks, and feedback loops so models earn trust on the ground and keep improving after launch.
* **Drive adoption across the org.**
  Work with Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to embed AI into how teams actually work.
* **Partner deeply with data science and engineering.**
  Shape problem formulation, data requirements, evaluation methodology, and model-versus-rules trade-offs. Understand precision/recall, drift, latency, and cost well enough to challenge and be challenged.
* **Run rigorous experimentation.**
  A/B tests, shadow deployments, and phased rollouts across geographies and hubs, with clear go/no-go criteria.
* **Stay at the frontier.**
  Evaluate new LLM, agentic, and vision capabilities, and decide pragmatically what to build, buy, or fine-tune.

**The kind of problems you could own**

* **Network intelligence:**
  demand forecasting, capacity planning, dynamic routing, and ETA prediction across the network
* **Last-mile optimization:**
  address intelligence and geocoding, delivery-attempt prediction, route and slot optimization, rider productivity
* **Computer vision on the ground:**
  shipment damage detection, automated weighing and dimensioning, sort-center throughput, proof-of-delivery verification
* **Generative AI and agents:**
  autonomous customer support, ops copilots for hub managers, document and invoice automation, internal knowledge assistants
* **Risk and trust:**
  fraud, RTO (return-to-origin) prediction, NDR resolution, and merchant risk scoring
* **Pricing and commercial intelligence:**
  dynamic pricing, serviceability, and yield optimization

You will be matched to problem statements based on impact, your strengths, and the stage of each problem. Expect to work across more than one.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Experience**

* 2–5 years in product management, ideally with at least 1–2 years shipping ML or AI-driven products (or a strong data science, ML engineering, or analytics background that you have transitioned into product)
* A track record of taking a product from ambiguous problem to measurable business impact
* Strong academic grounding; engineering degree from a top-tier institution preferred, MBA a plus but not required

**Skills**

* Working fluency in ML concepts: model evaluation, training data quality, feedback loops, and the practical differences between classical ML, deep learning, and LLM-based systems
* Hands-on comfort with data: SQL is a must, Python or notebooks a plus. You pull your own numbers.
* Experience with, or sharp point of view on, GenAI product design: prompt and eval design, RAG, agents, guardrails, and cost/latency trade-offs
* Excellent structured thinking and the ability to communicate with engineers, data scientists, and frontline ops leaders equally well
* Bias to action, ownership, and comfort operating in complex, high-volume, real-world environments

**Pedigree signals we value**

* Prior experience at product-led or AI-forward companies (marketplaces, e-commerce, mobility, fintech, SaaS, or AI-native startups)
* Evidence of impact: shipped models or AI features with quantifiable results, side projects, or published work
* Curiosity about the physical world: supply chains, operations, and hardware-meets-software problems

jobs.title: Corporate Subscriptions Product Owner
jobs.description:
Product · Bengaluru

You make *The Ken’s* corporate subscription a product that companies want, that their employees use, and that gets better every quarter.

Bengaluru; full-time; 2 to 4 years of experience.

  

Link Copied

  

### **About the role**

Companies already buy *The Ken* for their people. Corporate subscriptions are a significant percentage of our subscription revenue and one of the fastest-growing parts of it.

We want a corporate product that companies large and small find compelling enough to buy on their own, through the self-serve path we’ve had since 2018, without needing to be sold to. Something a 24-year-old analyst, a 34-year-old manager, and a 48-year-old business head can each use, even if what they take from it differs. Something that bundles in what we already do well beyond the daily story, such as workshops, talks, and live events, so they become part of an annual relationship rather than one-off revenue. Something that is visibly used, so that renewal is the default.

This role owns that product.

### **What you will do**

**Own the corporate product.** Define what a corporate subscription includes, for whom, at what tiers, and why. Write it down, ship it, keep changing it as you learn.

**Design for three kinds of employee.** Work out what early-career, mid-level, and senior people each need from *The Ken* and build the experiences that serve them: onboarding paths, briefings, formats, cohorts. One login for everyone is the starting point, not the product.

**Package what we already make.** Turn workshops, talks, live events, podcasts, and newsletters into things a corporate customer gets as part of the subscription. Decide what’s included, what’s an add-on, and what we stop.

**Own onboarding, activation, and engagement.** The product is only as good as the share of seats that get used. Build the onboarding flow, the activation nudges, and the account-level engagement view, and make seat usage a number everyone can see.

**Make the self-serve path work for companies.** A company should be able to discover, evaluate, buy, and expand without a call, and the buyer’s experience (admin, billing, seat management, reporting) should be as good as the reader’s.

**Define the measurement, then decide by it.** We don’t have account-level or seat-level measurement today. Define what it should count (seats active, engagement by segment, renewal, and expansion) and get it built. Know which packages activate, which features drive renewal, and where companies drop off. Kill what isn’t working.

**Talk to customers constantly.** HR and L&D buyers, the business heads who sponsor a subscription, the employees who use it or don’t. Bring what you hear into the product every month.

**Feed the people who sell.** Give them a product that’s easy to explain, obviously different, and backed by usage data that makes the renewal conversation short.

**Hold the line with the newsroom.** Many corporate customers are companies we’ve reported on critically, and they still buy. That’s the point. Exclusive features for corporates mean access, format, convenience, and curation. We never soften coverage. You keep that clear.

### **What we are looking for**

2 to 4 years in product management, growth, or a product-adjacent role at a subscription or B2B software business, ideally one where companies could buy without a salesperson. We care more about what you’ve owned and what happened to its numbers than where you worked.

You will do well here if:

– You’ve owned something end to end and can show what its numbers did while you had it.
  
– You’ve talked to enough customers to have been surprised by them.
  
– You like working out what different people need from the same product, and you’re happy building for a 24-year-old and a 48-year-old at once.
  
– You can build and read a funnel, a cohort view, and a renewal forecast, and present them to the founders monthly.
  
– You’ve killed something you built because the data said so.
  
– You can work across software, content, events, and people in the same week: an onboarding email, a workshop, a per-seat pricing argument.
  
– You read *The Ken* or something like it, and you’d rather sell a hard product honestly than an easy one loosely.
  
– Bonus: experience with L&D buyers, with packaging events or workshops into a subscription, or with seat-based pricing and activation metrics.

### **What you get**

A product of your own, with revenue attached, in a company small enough that your decisions ship. A customer base that already buys and renews, and that nobody has yet built a real product for. Resources in place: self-serve rails, a product and design team, events and workshops to bundle. And, over a year, the experience most product people at 2 to 4 years never get: owning a line from packaging to renewal, with the numbers to prove it.

Have questions?
  
Mail us at careers@the-ken.com with the name of the position in the subject line.

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Leads complex product management work, programs, projects, or initiatives across a broad area of responsibility in alignment with product, departmental, functional, and business objectives.  
2. Translates business plans, client needs, product priorities, and functional objectives into actionable recommendations, work plans, and execution approaches.  
3. Provides subject matter expertise on complex products, processes, services, or product life-cycle activities, advising stakeholders on risks, opportunities, dependencies, and potential solutions.  
4. Partners with senior functional leaders, business line stakeholders, Legal, regulatory contacts, and cross-functional partners to interpret business challenges, align priorities, and support strategic and operational decision-making.  
5. Identifies and resolves complex product, process, operational, or client-related issues by analyzing information from multiple sources, applying sound judgment, and leveraging appropriate resources within and outside the function.  
6. Recommends and implements best practices, product enhancements, service improvements, and process changes that strengthen efficiency, quality, control effectiveness, and business outcomes.  
7. Leads or contributes to high-impact initiatives requiring cross-functional coordination, influence, change management, and execution discipline across the product life cycle.  
8. Uses data, metrics, reporting, market or client insights, and performance information to guide decisions, evaluate outcomes, and identify improvement opportunities.  
9. Develops and maintains strong strategic working relationships with peers, senior staff, functional partners, and other stakeholders to drive alignment and sustained performance.  
10. Serves as a technical or functional resource for colleagues by sharing expertise, providing guidance on complex matters, and supporting consistent execution of product-related work.  
11. Performs all duties according to established policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.

**KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS**

* Specialized depth and/or breadth of expertise in own discipline or field, with the ability to apply that expertise to complex product management work.
* Strong business acumen and ability to interpret internal and external business challenges to recommend best practices, product enhancements, or process improvements.
* Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to resolve complex issues using sound judgment and appropriate collaboration or escalation.
* Ability to influence outcomes, negotiate change, and guide stakeholders across areas of responsibility without direct people management authority.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to advise senior functional management and build strategic relationships across the function.
* Experience leading complex initiatives, coordinating cross-functional work, and maintaining execution discipline across multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Knowledge of product management activities, operational processes, controls, risk considerations, and product life-cycle requirements within the area of responsibility.
* Ability to use data, metrics, reporting, and performance information to guide recommendations, measure outcomes, and improve product or process effectiveness.

**EDUCATION/ EXPERIENCE**

Bachelor’s/University degree required; advanced degree preferred. Typically 8+ years of relevant experience, including experience managing complex products, processes, programs, or initiatives; advising stakeholders on product-related matters; and influencing cross-functional outcomes in alignment with business objectives.

**Eligibility - Internal Partners**

  

* 2 years as Senior Consultant/Associate Specialist/Section Manager/Operations Manager to move as a Specialist
* 1 year as Division Manager to move as a Specialist

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's operations network (Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres) is the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. It moves billions of units of inventory, employs tens of thousands of people, and makes sure customers get what they want when promised. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 pilots and proves new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, before they scale across this network.  
  
The Innovation Lab is looking for a passionate, results-oriented Business Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment. The selected candidate will build and maintain the data platform, tools and reporting that tell us whether each pilot is working. They will also dig into the data to find the root cause of defects and give the team the evidence it needs to decide which solutions scale. The BA will also support hands-on pilot execution on the floor when required.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Build the data foundation for every trial: write the SQL queries and extracts that pull pilot data from operational systems
* Design and maintain dashboards that show each trial's progress against its success criteria
* Set up alerts and exception reports that flag when a trial metric moves off target, so the team can act the same day
* Monitor the health of DWP jobs, dashboards and data sources, and keep them reliable (target: 100% availability)
* Find and fix the root cause of data issues and trouble tickets (failed jobs, missing or mismatched data)
* Define the data plan for each pilot (metrics, baseline, collection method) before the trial starts
* Own the lab scorecard and daily pilot report, and prepare the data for weekly business reviews and leadership updates
* Analyse dashboard and alert trends to find the root cause of defects and underperformance, and propose specific actions
* Support site-readiness analysis when a solution moves to a new site
* Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan
* Collect physical data (time studies, downtime and fault logs) and keep the issue log up to date
* Follow and enforce pilot-area safety controls, including pre-trial checks for automation zones

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of data analytics or automation experience
* 1+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
* Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of SQL/Python/R, scripting, MS Excel, table joins, and aggregate analytical functions

The GSF LM team at Amazon India is hiring for a Business Analyst position, seeking a candidate with a strong performance record and hands-on experience in data-driven decision-making. The role requires exceptional analytical skills, the ability to break down complex problems into structured, executable plans, and comfort with high ambiguity in a fast-paced environment. The candidate must be proficient in Macro and SQL, experienced with BI tools, and capable of working with big data from multiple sources. Core responsibilities include setting up robust processes to drive consumer experience improvements, identifying and executing automation projects, building scalable solutions using SQL, Amazon S3 and Quick Sight, and rolling out best practices from other geographies to minimize end-to-end supply chain losses. The candidate should demonstrate the ability to influence stakeholders across business, operations, and technical functions using data and facts, and earn trust across varied teams without formal authority. Candidates are expected to demonstrate a high bar on Bias for Action, Deep Dive, Learn and Be Curious, Insist on the Highest Standards, and Ownership.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities  
1. Set up and maintain robust processes to drive improvement projects with an objective to maximize consumer experience across the LM network.  
2. Identify, plan, and execute automation projects within the team to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.  
3. Create and work on data using SQL, Amazon S3, and QuickSight to generate actionable insights for business and operations teams.  
4. Support business growth in constrained environments through frugal and innovative solutions, ensuring scalability without proportional cost increase.  
5. Make existing processes scalable by identifying and implementing available tools, automation, and AI-driven solutions.  
6. Roll out best practices from other geographies and standardize tools and processes to minimize end-to-end supply chain losses.  
7. Partner with business, operations, and technical stakeholders to translate complex operational challenges into structured, data-backed recommendations.  
8. Utilize strong problem-solving and communication skills to influence decisions across business, operations, and technical audiences.  
  
About the team  
IN GSF Last Mile team supports three business lines: Amazon Fresh (including Ultra-Fast Fresh [UFF] and 3P Hybrid stores network, Sub Same Day, and Amazon Now (quick commerce). Amazon Fresh offers full basket service (daily essentials including Produce and Perishables) through UFF sites and 3P Hybrid retail partnerships. Sub Same Day specializes in local fulfillment via Same day delivery with 2 & 4-hour delivery windows. Amazon Now supports 10-25 minutes delivery of everyday essentials including groceries, electronics, OTC, and household consumables.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of data analytics or automation experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
* Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of SQL/Python/R, scripting, MS Excel, table joins, and aggregate analytical functions
* Experience in data analytics or automation

As a Business Analyst III at Amazon, you will tackle ambiguous, high-impact problems by combining deep analytical expertise with a thorough understanding of business objectives. **About WeRize**

Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).

This customer segments not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health and life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit. While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need properguidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on-the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when comparedto upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t workfor this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.
